title: Timing authority vector accepts IPv6 source unrelated to signer key
description: generate_packets_timing.py hardcodes fe80::2 for an authenticated DIO signed by a seed whose key-derived IID is b19edad2958934e1; packets-timing.json marks it authoritative, contradicting authenticated_schc_dio source/signer rejection vectors. Derive the IPv6 source from the signing public key, regenerate timing vectors/signatures, and make consumers enforce source-IID plus root AddrForKey binding before time authority mutation.
